# Redefines a term

`Glossary: gls-redefines-a-term` `DRAFT`

Covering `redefinition-unlinked`. Both entries redefine a term `gls-circular-definition` defines. The first links that
entry's anchor, which is the case the rule passes over. The second links nothing, and neither does the entry it
redefines, so a reader who finds one never learns of the other.

## Scope

The words a search service uses for its own fields.

## Terms

### Catalogue

The index a search runs against. See [gls-circular-definition.catalogue].

### Export

A download of the results a search returned.

[gls-circular-definition.catalogue]: circular-definition.md#catalogue
